title: Stabilization of Unidirectional First-Order PDE-ODE Coupled Systems with Boundary and Distributed Input Delays
summary: The paper considers a system of unidirectional first-order hyperbolic partial differential equations (PDEs) coupled with ordinary differential equations (ODEs), modeling two-phase advective transport processes subject to both boundary and distributed input delays. To address the system defined over two spatial domains, we design a set of three backstepping transformations involving both Volterra- and Fredholm-type integral operators, which introduce eight kernel functions: five associated with the PDE states and three with the ODE states.
